name: SolanAuth
summary: Responsive Solana wallet sign-in and account modal for Next.js, built on @solana/web3.js with NextAuth and shadcn/ui.
description: A Solana wallet authentication and account modal: responsive wallet sign-in on top of @solana/web3.js with NextAuth integration and shadcn/ui styling. The repo holds the Next.js demo app (components, hooks, providers, Tailwind config); the homepage renders client-side only, so most of its text is not readable by crawlers.
contains: responsive Solana wallet auth and account modal
shadcn/ui styling; Tailwind config in repo
credits vaul, credenza and solana wallet adapter
